user_query: Why did LINE avoid comparing itself with MDS, IsoMap, and Laplacian eigenmap, and what scale of networks did the evaluated datasets have?
llm_response: LINE avoided comparing itself with MDS, IsoMap, and Laplacian eigenmap because those methods are not designed to scale to the very large graphs LINE targets; they are computationally too expensive for the network sizes LINE was evaluating. The evaluated datasets were large-scale networks, ranging from tens of thousands to millions of nodes (with millions of edges in some cases).
llm_confidence_reasoning: This matches the standard explanation in the LINE paper and the reported dataset scale, though exact dataset-by-dataset sizes are not reproduced here.
